notes: No Clarity site (elections.json 404). The seed site https://www.taylorcounty.texas.gov/ and the results pages found by one web search (214/Current-Election, 549/Archived-Election-Results, CivicPlus) were refused by the fetch module as robots_disallowed_or_unreachable; the cached robots.txt check shows 'URLError: [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer'. Per the brief this was accepted and not worked around, so no county-posted reports could be read. Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not found on origin). Targeted pass 3 2026-10-02 (targeted3-C): the county site now loads through the fetch module (earlier robots.txt resets are gone). 2026_primary changed UNDETERMINED to LATER (check 2). The Current Election page (CivicPlus) lists, for 'JOINT PRIMARY ELECTION March 3, 2026', every release: 'Early Voting Results' (DocumentCenter/View/5012 Dem, 5013 Rep), '1st Release Election Day Results' (5015, 5014), 'Final Unofficial Results' (5016, 5017), 'OFFICIAL Results' (5038, 5039) and 'OFFICIAL Precinct Report' (5042, 5043). The unofficial files are scanned printouts (Xerox AltaLink) of the county-level 'Republican Party - Cumulative Report' / 'Democratic Party - Cumulative Report' with printed Run Time 7:14 PM, 9:02 PM and 10:35 PM on 03/03/2026 (scan CreationDate 2026-03-04 01:25, 03:10 and 04:47 UTC, that is 7:25 PM, 9:10 PM and 10:47 PM CST); they carry no per-precinct numbers. The only precinct-level report is 'OFFICIAL Precinct Report', printed Run Date 03/11/2026 3:47 PM (PDF CreationDate 2026-03-11 20:48 UTC), after canvass. DocumentCenter sends no Last-Modified header, so there is no upload time; the printed run times decide under rule 43. Caveat: the page today could omit an election-night precinct file that was later removed, but it keeps every early and unofficial release, which supports the reading. 2024_general: no file for the Nov 5 2024 general is listed on the Current or Archived Election Results pages (archive skips from 'March 5, 2024' primaries to 2025; a web search for a 2024 general results document found only DocumentCenter/View/4451, which is the March 5, 2024 Republican primary official cumulative report). 2026_runoff: no May 26 2026 runoff results are listed on any Taylor elections page; one web search found none. Both stay UNDETERMINED. Wayback harvest for taylorcounty.texas.gov failed (robots_disallowed_or_unreachable); no targeted archive or sweep files for Taylor on the wayback-data branch (sweep pending). Platform set to county_pdfs (CivicPlus DocumentCenter PDFs).

No Last-Modified header (no upload time); printed run times decide (rule 43).
